description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 — a `.run()` result used as a value is the driver's row array; it is tagged like `.all()` and the sink strips the protected column.
rationale: §14.8.9: the tag is attached "at `?{}` query-lowering" to every output row. Only `.get()` / `.all()` were tagged; `let rows = ?{`SELECT * FROM users`}.run(); return rows` (and a bare `?{}` used as a value) served passwordHash over HTTP (measured, S443 round 6).
